description: register.tsx (the "modules" entry above): the plan band, the Plan pane and the plan event relay as native function hooks, tested by `claude plugin test danxbot` and validated by `claude plugin validate danxbot` before every publish (publish.sh needs the claude CLI: CLAUDE_BIN). Command hooks, all through launch.mjs: launch.mjs: every command below runs through it; it verifies the plugin's files against integrity-manifest.json first, restores a damaged one from the marketplace clone, and reports what it cannot restore. event-hook.sh: for a plan-connected session, the registry's effective text for SessionStart (startup/resume/compaction) and for every sub-agent (any type, any plugin) at SubagentStart; silent when not connected. ensure-dashboard-mcp.sh: installs the recorded danx-dashboard-mcp version (the registry's latest, recorded at session start) into the plugin data dir once, so the fetch runs it with node, never a cold npx. background-work-report.mjs: reports running background work to quiet the idle nudge. activity-report.mjs: tells the dashboard when a sub-agent starts or finishes and when a background Bash call starts, so the session's running count closes. ready-cards-stop.mjs: blocks a plan-connected session's stop once while its plan has ready, unclaimed cards. inject-time.sh: wall clock with UTC offset. Which danx-dashboard-mcp version runs: the three session-start entry points (ensure-dashboard-mcp.sh --prewarm, event-hook.sh SessionStart, background-work-report.mjs session-start) refresh the recorded version from the npm registry's latest; every other hook reads the record and makes no registry request.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launch.mjs" --via stdout scripts/inject-time.sh UserPromptSubmit || echo '[danxbot plugin] a danxbot hook failed to run, so the plugin install may be corrupt. Fix: run `claude plugin uninstall danxbot --keep-data`, then `claude plugin install danxbot` (add `--config dashboard_url=<address>` if you had set a custom dashboard address, which a reinstall forgets), then restart the session.'
